name: Workyard Exterior U3 Chopping Station v1 — Concept Fidelity
subtitle: Weathered chopping block, embedded felling axe, and half-sawn sawbuck
review_note: Closeout revision: the stump is now ONE continuous lofted hand-hewn trunk (no terraces) with root flares, bark striation, and a pale scarred top whose rim scar lies flush; the saw cut is a thin dark slit following the log's own cross-section over its top half, matching the concept's partial cut. The complete forged axe still enters the wood over a split bruise and hairline crack on its curved two-segment haft. Remaining deviations: the axe stands slightly more upright than the concept and the chips are sparser.
improve: None blocking; both previously banked next-pass targets (kerf slit, continuous trunk) are resolved and re-audited from all four cardinals.
